_do_not_auto_overwrite: Hand-adjudicated GENUINE-BLIND FULL-COVERAGE cold pass (6/6 in-scope files, coverage_fraction=1.0) WITH THE CHECKLIST PASS ACTIVE (pattern_checklist generated before reveal). Only counts (6H/19M) + scope peeked; titles SEALED on code4rena until reveal. ALL 25 awarded findings listed below (matched + missed) so the full-coverage headline aggregates honestly.

awarded.title: Wrong minting logic based on total token count across generations
awarded.label: STRONG
awarded.note: STRONG: T-04 nailed it -- mintWithBudget loop gates on global _tokenIds instead of generationMintCounts[currentGeneration], unusable after 10000 total mints; same root cause + fix.

awarded.title: Griefing attack on seller's airdrop benefits
awarded.label: MISSED
awarded.note: MISS (noticed-but-not-raised): I EXPLICITLY noted in _coverage that burn/nuke call airdrop.subUserAmount(initialOwners[tokenId]) using the INITIAL owner not the current owner, but dismissed it instead of raising the griefing impact (a later owner burns/nukes a transferred token, slashing the original minter's airdrop entropy).

awarded.title: Incorrect percentage calculation when taxCut changed from default
awarded.label: MISSED
awarded.note: MISS (reasoning gap): I read `devShare = msg.value / taxCut` (NukeFund.receive) and `devFee = forgingFee / taxCut` (EntityForging) and treated taxCut=10 as '10%' without flagging that these compute 1/taxCut, NOT taxCut% -- so any owner change of taxCut produces wrong fee splits.

awarded.title: Number of entities in generation can surpass 10k
awarded.label: MISSED
awarded.note: MISS (reasoning gap): I read _incrementGeneration (resets generationMintCounts[currentGeneration]=0) and _mintNewEntity (forging into gen+1) but did not connect that forged entities pre-seeded into the next generation are wiped by the reset, letting the new generation exceed maxTokensPerGen.

awarded.title: The maximum number of generations is infinite
awarded.label: MISSED
awarded.note: MISS (reasoning gap): forge() checks newGeneration <= maxGeneration but the mint path's _incrementGeneration has no maxGeneration guard, so generations increment past the intended cap of 10.

awarded.title: mintToken/mintWithBudget/forge fail due to wrong modifier (onlyOwner vs onlyAllowedCaller) in initializeAlphaIndices
awarded.label: STRONG
awarded.note: STRONG: T-01 is exact -- initializeAlphaIndices is onlyOwner but invoked by the NFT contract on generation increment -> reverts -> mint/forge DoS once a generation fills. Same root cause + fix (use onlyAllowedCaller).

awarded.title: Uninitialized entropySlots read in getNextEntropy -> 0 entropy mint
awarded.label: MISSED
awarded.note: MISS: I reasoned about array bounds/reset but assumed batches are initialized before minting; did not flag the pre-init 0-entropy mint window.

awarded.title: Funds can be locked indefinitely in NukeFund (no withdrawal beyond nuke())
awarded.label: MISSED
awarded.note: MISS: focused on nuke economics (T-03), not the no-exit case where all NFTs burned leaves fund stranded.

awarded.label: MISSED
awarded.note: MISS: I verified DevFund reward-debt math as internally consistent; this cross-contract interaction (a dev who is also a minter) was not modeled.

awarded.title: Forger Entities can forge more times than intended
awarded.label: STRONG
awarded.note: STRONG: T-06 identified the exact mechanism -- listForForging gate is `forgingCounts <= forgePotential` (inclusive), letting an entity forge forgePotential+1 times. (I rated it Low; awarded Medium, but the mechanism is nailed.)

awarded.title: Nuke DoSed for three days after listing and canceling sale
awarded.label: SAME_AREA
awarded.note: SAME_AREA: T-09 identified the root cause (canTokenBeNuked uses lastTokenTransferredTimestamp which resets on every transfer, and listing on EntityTrading is a transfer); the awarded framing is the list-then-CANCEL self-grief (cancel transfers the NFT back, resetting the owner's own 3-day clock). Same mechanism, did not headline the cancel-path self-DoS.

awarded.label: STRONG
awarded.note: STRONG: T-05 is exact -- forgeWithListed requires msg.value >= forgingFee, distributes only forgingFee, never refunds the excess -> trapped. Same root cause + fix.
